stop_rule: If the advertised contributions reduce to known multi-risk testing, bundling independent clusters, and pre-specified adaptive policy selection, mark methodological novelty gate false and do not execute the 256-output DEV merely to rediscover degradation.
scope_note: Mathematical toy examples are not LLM measurements, safety certificates, or claims that every possible extension has been solved.
